title: Source locality of the universal single-rank predicate
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $E,F$ be module sheaves on $X$. If every point $t\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $V$ such that $R_1(f,E,F,g\circ\iota_V)$ holds [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match], then $R_1(f,E,F,g)$ holds. No flatness, properness or finite local freeness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Fix h:Tprime->T and t in Tprime. Choose V with h(t) in V from hlocal. Let A=h^{-1}(V) and v=h restricted to V. Apply the universal single-rank predicate on V to v and the point (t,htA), obtaining U, rank r, and both rank witnesses. Rewrite the two test morphisms using morphismRestrict_ι, transporting equality explicitly by congrArg to avoid dependent pullback-instance rewriting.

Set j=U.ι followed by A.ι and W=j.opensRange. Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq identifies U with W, with inverse e.inv and e.inv followed by j equal to W.ι. The chosen point of U maps to t, so t belongs to W. Construct jX between X_A and X_Tprime by pullback.lift. IsPullback.of_right verifies the open base-change square, and MorphismProperty.of_isPullback makes jX an open immersion. The private pushforward_restrict_square proves the sectionwise restriction/direct-image comparison using SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr₂ and the equality of inverse-image/image opens. Identify tensor pullback with Mathlib pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, and with restriction along open immersions. Compose this comparison with tensor pullback composition [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition] to obtain directImageOpenIso. Transport the direct-image witness through this isomorphism and tensorPullbackComp to get rank r after tensor pullback by j. Pull back once more by e.inv and use e.inv followed by j = W.ι. Rank preservation here is the proved source-library instance Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback, transported through the tensor/abstract-pullback isomorphism; rank is invariant under sheaf isomorphisms. Reuse the already proved private tensorIso and tensorRankComp from PicardUniversalRankMatchConjunction via a proof-only import all; no duplicate rank-preservation theorem is declared.

For the reference witness, construct q:X_W->X_U by pullback.lift with first projection unchanged and second projection followed by e.inv. The equation e.inv followed by U.ι followed by A.ι = W.ι verifies the lift's commutativity. Then q followed by the first projection of X_U is the first projection of X_W. Rank preservation under pullback and tensor pullback composition [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition] transport the reference rank-r witness along q. The open W and the two transported witnesses satisfy the definition [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match]. Empty test schemes have no points to check; no finiteness or flatness hypothesis is used. The tensorRankComp used here is the existing private theorem of PicardUniversalRankMatchConjunction, not a local reproof.
